body:
I could not reproduce from your MRP, but I have a similar or same issue that cropped up in 4.6.

In 4.6, when loading(using `ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get`) with Vulkan it would take way longer and surge my ram anywhere from 6-13 gigabytes consistently, freezing/crashing the game, and after the loading finished the scene would take more idle RAM than normal. Though, that increase may be a nothingburger if it's just the system not freeing some of the now unused data from the previous ram surge. Direct X 12 is normal. These seem to be semi-related to having VoxelGI active in the scene tree, since I don't use Lightmap.

Also I did restart my PC, and it still happens.

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.23033.1002) - AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.15 GiB memory

Everything below measured in megabytes.
| RAM Usage in MB | Vulkan + VoxelGI(visible with baked data)| Vulkan + VoxelGI(not visible and no baked data) | dx12 + VoxelGI(visible with baked data) |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Godot Engine(open project) | idle 3.7k | idle 3.7k | idle 2.3k |
| Main Menu | idle .57k | idle .57k | idle .34k |
| Town | idle 1.8k :: high 3k | idle .87k :: high 2k | idle .54k |
| Dungeon | idle .80k :: high 6-13k | idle .90k :: high 2k | idle .65k :: high 1.3k |

Hope that's of some use, I'm just side stepping the issue by using dx12.
